source: All 12 authored Word references, training/corpus-review.json and frontend/vendor/paper-layout.js
format_scope: Measured family defaults, not a promise that every mixed-font paragraph in a reference has one font or size. Original Word export retains its original run properties.

objects.tables: Native Word cells, observed column proportions, multiline cell text, explicit repeating headers. Unchanged Word inputs also retain original merges.
objects.grids: Observed cell count; teacher-adjustable height; no completed answers.
objects.shapes: Editable native basic geometry. Complex scanned artwork retains original source pixels.
objects.pictures: Separate original assets, fixed physical width, aspect ratio retained, teacher alignment/crop/replacement controls. Never fabricated when missing.
objects.emphasis: Native Word underline, double underline, strike, inserted/replaced wording, highlight and run border.

source_word_export.retains: Original package parts, fonts, styles, image bytes, numbering, equations, links, headers, footers, native shapes and tables.
source_word_export.a4_adjustments: All section sizes/margins; fit oversized inline drawings/tables; keep section headings with their first question; put floating tables in page flow; avoid wrapping text beside wide anchored objects.
source_word_export.limits: Original source composition defects can remain. Native fonts require availability in the opening application. Browser extraction preview is not an exact Word rendering. Any teacher edit switches to the selected paper formatter.

verification.handwriting_accuracy: Not certified by layout tests. See training/LIVE_REVIEW.md.
verification.exact_pdf_word_pairs: Do not pair different assessments simply because the subject/class matches.
verification.training_method: Reference rules, prompts and deterministic layout; no hosted weight fine-tuning performed.
